population: Exactly the presealed context_feature_memory_replay_protocol_20261024.json 12 source groups, 20 videos and all 697 cached sampled frames. No new source/video/frame selection, favorable pair filter or score threshold.
candidate_set: For every adjacent cached sampled frame pair of each video: all current retained Q rows x ALL immediately previous sampled frame M retained rows, including unknown identities and released id=-1. The first frame and empty Q/M frames remain in the frame receipt. A previous empty frame gives zero candidates; do not jump backward to a nonempty frame.
coordinates: Original image xyxy boxes and original frame indices. No ego-motion compensation or seconds inferred. Original-frame gaps may be irregular.
history: For each reference row, use its released nonnegative (video_id,track_id) solely to locate the nearest earlier cached DIFFERENT frame occurrence, before the reference frame. id=-1 has no history. An ambiguous duplicate same-ID row in a history frame invalidates history until the next unique occurrence. Old IDs never define truth, positive labels, candidate selection or same-ID evaluation filtering. A reference frame containing duplicate same-ID rows gives no CV history to either duplicated current reference row even if an earlier unique occurrence exists; the next unique occurrence has no past history across that ambiguity and only establishes history for later references.
scores_high_is_positive: raw_appearance_cosine: float64 cosine of cached float16 raw256 cast to float64; zero-norm vector normalizes to zero
absolute_xyxy_cosine: cosine of original four absolute box coordinates, retained as the original position-style control
box_iou: ordinary continuous xyxy IoU of current and reference boxes, no inclusive pixel padding
negative_normalized_displacement_norm: negative Euclidean norm of geometry.normalized_displacement
negative_normalized_CV_innovation_norm: negative Euclidean norm of geometry.normalized_CV_innovation; missing history is NaN with explicit mask
semantic_embedding_cosine: ordinary cached averaged semantic512 cosine, separate control; no class correctness or branch training
seal_boundary: Compute and seal every GT-free candidate score/coordinate/row mapping and complete selected frame receipts BEFORE importing/calling the fit supervised identity helper or opening supervised_observations payload. Hash every selected input NPZ, fixed protocol/module and metadata before and after. Candidate score NPZ never receives GT fields.
identity_join: After GT-free seal only: exact eligible FIT manual identities from independently audited support, projected by observation_id and immutable GT-free index (image_id,dump_row). Decode split then skip tune before identity projection. Never decode gt_category_id/error/soft_risk/posterior_argmax_category_id. Unknown endpoint identity is label=-1, not a negative. Known labels compare (video_id,gt_track_id); no predicted ID is truth.
strata: Report all-known candidates and their same-emitted-predicted-category subset, using cached det_labels only. Within EACH of those scopes report all non-CV scores on its complete candidates, and a separate CV-covered scope where ALL six scores share exactly the CV-valid known denominator. No finite-value dropping by score; reject unexpected invalid scores.
statistics: For each of the fixed 12 sources and their union: known positive/negative pair counts, unique endpoint/source/video/official GT trajectory counts, unknown coverage, CV coverage, descriptive pair-level AUROC for each individual score. AUROC uses Mann-Whitney ranking with half credit for exact score ties and is null when either class is absent. Union AUROC is micro over known pairs; additionally report an unweighted mean of valid per-source AUROCs with its supported-source count. Pair counts and AUC are not independent-sample evidence, power, TETA or causal efficacy.
forbidden: No learning/fusion weights, score search, threshold tuning, positive-gain selection, pair model, GT reference purification, tune/test/heldout correctness, GPU, real readout/cache or network modification. All declared features/scopes/sources reported; no best-score selection.

round1: All QxM including id=-1 and previous-empty frame behavior; original-frame irregular CV gap
Past-only history no current-query leakage; no-ID history and duplicate-ID history invalidation
round2: High-good feature signs, exact raw/semantic cosine, translation effect on absolute versus relative geometry
Tie-aware AUROC brute-force parity, absent class null, shared CV denominator
Paired top1 repair/break and positive-negative order transitions; deterministic immutable-row tie, no-positive query coverage, common CV ranking denominator
round3: Seal-before-fit-identity join, tune/outcome decoder poison and unknown-not-negative
Permutation candidate completeness/row mapping, no source/input mutation and complete zero-candidate frame receipts

interpretation: This tests which cached individual cues distinguish sparse eligible manual identities on a fixed exploratory FIT population. CV history may inherit original tracker errors; no ego compensation or dynamics validity is established. AUROC does not establish an operating threshold, assignment improvement, learned fusion value, generalization or novelty. Current five-mode experiment remains a memory intervention; geometry remains nonlearned. Geometry AUROC alone does not establish information incremental to appearance. Paired ranking tables are descriptive complementarity checks on sparse eligible manual identities and a conditional known-reference subset, not deployed complete-candidate top1 or assignment gain. Positive-negative pair comparisons may share endpoints and queries.
query_ranking: After sealing and identity join, each of all-candidate and same-emitted-predicted-category scopes uses exactly one common CV-valid known-candidate mask for all six scores. Group by immutable (video_id,query_image_id,query_dump_row). Primary top1 table uses queries with at least one positive and at least one negative in that fixed subset. Also report all nonempty-known queries, including no-positive queries scored wrong for every feature, with positive/negative availability, source/video/query counts and candidate counts. Each feature chooses highest score then lowest immutable reference dump_row on ties; GT never resolves a tie. Report paired rawcos-to-feature correct/wrong 2x2 transitions, repair raw error and break raw correct. Within the positive-and-negative-available queries also compare every known positive with every known negative: win/tie/loss counts and 3x3 rawcos-to-feature order transition matrix, strict loss-to-win repair and win-to-loss break. No GT affects the complete sealed candidate set.
sampling_gap_coverage: Report original-frame gap min/median/max/full Counter once per adjacent sampled frame pair, including empty frames, rather than weighting by candidate count. Report history-to-reference original-frame gaps once per reference observation with available past history, never once per query-reference pair. Complete GT-free frame receipts retain both gap records.
